description: Japanese basics, ramen, sushi, Korean, rice noodles, soba, Indian and sous vide — step by step with pictures.
footer: Tap ingredients and steps to tick them off while you cook.

notes.html:
• Follow the packet’s stir-fry preparation instructions, stopping while they still have a little firmness.
  • Drain well and use promptly; they’ll finish cooking in the sauce.
  • Avoid fully softening them beforehand or aggressively stirring them in the pan.

• Beyond the basics:
    • oyster sauce
    • dark soy sauce
    • fish sauce
    • tamarind purée
    • mushrooms
    • bok choy
    • spring onions
    • eggs
    • bean sprouts
    • roasted peanuts
    • lime
  • Bok choy can cover both of the first two dishes, so there’s no need to buy separate greens.

lede_html: Japanese basics and big projects, sushi, Korean kimchi and fried chicken, weeknight rice noodles and soba, Indian chicken tikka and a sous vide reference — each with step-by-step pictures, mise-en-place order and a prep timeline.
